project_name: NTT Global Data Centers DN1 Adams County facility
aliases: NTT Global Data Centers Adams County
developer: NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc.
status_detail: Adams County Resolution 2025-518 approved an incentive agreement for NTT Global Data Centers Americas and NTT Global Data Centers DN1 to construct an approximately 300,000-square-foot data center facility, substation, and site improvements on a 76-acre site in Aerotropolis Logistics Center in Aurora, Adams County, with about $647.5 million in new machinery/equipment and at least 27 jobs by end of 2028.
notes: County resolution is the controlling evidence; no MW stated in the resolution.
